recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait featuring a person in a white blazer on the right, balanced by their own dark, sharp-edged silhouette projected onto a cool blue-grey gradient background on the left.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject and shadow as equal compositional weights
Bright white garment against a muted blue-grey atmosphere
Sharp typographic block anchoring the top edge
Symmetrical hand-on-hip posing between the real figure and the shadow
coreInvariants: The shadow must be a solid, dark silhouette without internal detail
The background must feature a soft radial gradient from light blue to dark grey
The subject must wear a high-contrast white or light-colored structured jacket

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures (one real, one shadow) occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally as a pair.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy black-on-white title bar at the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold title, drops to the dark silhouette, moves across to the illuminated face, and settles on the fine metadata at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space around the heads and between the two figures to emphasize the gradient background.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with extreme value contrast between the white jacket and the black shadow.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are knocked out of a solid rectangular block

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a white rectangular bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a heavy, industrial display face and a light, delicate secondary face.
graphicDevices: Solid white horizontal bar for title

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Impact or Gill Sans Ultra Bold
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, blocky presence of the main title.
Captures the delicate, humanist feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a person in a white blazer with hands on hips, standing against a blue-grey gradient wall. A sharp, dark silhouette of the same person is projected onto the wall to their left, mirroring their pose.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a solid white horizontal bar at the top left containing bold black uppercase sans-serif text. Add small white lowercase text in parentheses at the top right.

verificationChecks: Is the title text black inside a white bar?
Is the silhouette sharp and completely dark?
Is the background a smooth blue-grey gradient?
Is the subject wearing a bright white jacket?

adjustableVariables: Width of the white title bar
Subject's specific pose (as long as it is mirrored by the shadow)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any existing brand logos or record label marks
Exact tracklist text at the bottom
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the shadow does not have facial features
Check that the white bar is perfectly horizontal
Verify the blue gradient is subtle and not banded
Confirm the text is legible against the background
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in white + Mirrored silhouette + Blue gradient background + Blocky header bar = New Wave Aesthetic.
